verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero photo of praying hands: A crops it to a black strip at the top, leaving a ghosted white cross fragment at left and a big empty bottom. B is worse: it slices the photo into two black rectangles, one at the top and one at the bottom, with white crosses on black that look like stray artifacts, plus the cloud shapes become faint white outlines at left. B's quote and name are also cramped together. A's text is clean and readable with a clear hierarchy, so it is the less bad of the two.
